# Products

The four things HARTLE.TECH ships (or is shipping).

## NearTrace

Android BLE scanner. Forensic-grade nearby-device discovery — log, track, and visualize devices around you by signal strength. Play-Store-safe build is the canonical lane.

- Marketing: [neartrace.app](https://neartrace.app)
- Engineering: [neartrace.hartle.tech](https://neartrace.hartle.tech) *(wip)*

## Medusa

ESP32-S3 in a phone case. Passive RF recon for defensive research. The MCU branch of the phone-as-UI hacking-case-kit family.

- Product: [medusa.hartle.tech](https://medusa.hartle.tech)

## DumpSock

Cloudless iPhone backup. Pull data off your phone with no third-party cloud in the path.

- Product: [dumpsock.hartle.tech](https://dumpsock.hartle.tech)

## Nosferato

The NOT-SAFE-FOR-APP-STORES Pi rig — companion to NearTrace, sibling to Medusa. Vampire-hacker-rat aesthetic; lives on its own branch and ships off-store only.
